## v0.5.52 · Maintenance and stable README links / 维护整理与稳定的 README 链接

### English

- Remove unused code and simplify internal names across the Host, Client, tests and official plugins. Published SDK deprecation notices are preserved. (#712–#715)
- Consolidate release history into the bilingual changelog. Historical review files remain available in earlier tagged snapshots. (#711)
- The Starter package pins its bilingual README links to the release commit. The existing installation, WebUI and Skills galleries are available at their current paths. (#711)

### 简体中文

- 清理 Host、Client、测试和官方插件中的未用代码，简化内部命名，保留公开 SDK 的弃用提示。（#712–#715）
- 将版本历史集中到双语更新日志，历史评审资料可从此前的版本标签查看。（#711）
- Starter 包内的双语 README 使用固定提交链接。安装、WebUI 和技能图集继续使用现有地址。（#711）

Update from **Memory System → Status → Versions → Update**, then fully restart DSH. / 在**记忆系统 → 状态 → 检查版本 → 更新**中升级，然后完整重启 DSH。
